overview: The Medford Traffic Commission considered several residential permit parking variances, approved crosswalk daylighting safety measures on High Street and Fulton Street, and adjusted winter emergency parking rules on Gaston Street.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Commission approved the minutes of the January 19, 2023 meeting.

items.title: Handicap Parking Sign - 525 Main Street
items.summary: The Commission tabled a petition for a handicap parking sign at 525 Main Street because the petitioner was not present.

items.title: Permit Parking Variance - 7 Edward Place
items.summary: The Commission approved a resident permit parking variance allowing a resident of 7 Edward Place to park on Edward Street.

items.title: Crosswalk Daylighting Restrictions
items.summary: The Commission approved crosswalk daylighting proposals to eliminate single parking spaces approaching crosswalks on Fulton Street and High Street to improve sight lines.

items.title: Temporary Parking Variance - 1 Irving Street
items.summary: The Commission voted to delegate authority to the Chief of Police to arrange temporary parking accommodations for a traveling healthcare worker at 1 Irving Street.

items.title: Visitor Pass Request - 465 Broadway
items.summary: The Commission approved a request for a Bow Street visitor parking pass for a resident of 465 Broadway.

items.title: Visitor Pass Request - 18 Cottage Street
items.summary: The item was withdrawn from the agenda at the petitioner's request.

items.title: Spencer Road Permit Parking Opt-Out Petition
items.summary: The Commission re-tabled an opt-out petition from Spencer Road residents because no petitioners were present to speak.

items.title: Gaston Street Winter Emergency Parking Designation
items.summary: The Commission approved a petition designating winter emergency parking on Gaston Street to the odd-numbered side permanently.

items.title: Alston Court Parking Request
items.summary: The Commission referred a parking variance request for 6 Alston Court to the Police Department Traffic Division to research existing regulations and ticketing history.
